about: Reviewed observations of the Don Julio walk-in T1 run (2026-10-26, thread F0F3D5FB, job ac91bb4f-fea6-4f9e-a429-67e8b8507f85, prod a2426885d): what the phone rendered vs what the creator watched and saved from the iPhone editor. Measured locally with ffprobe/ffmpeg on the run's two files and read from the job record (admin jobs/<id>/debug). No media, URLs or transcripts.
request: Start at my question "Parrilla Don Julio, what do you think?" and end right after "Nice!" (kit T1_atakan_tail_take_talking/PROMPT.txt); speech cleanup off (off_v1).

phone_render.observed: opens on Atakan at the plaque saying the start line; captions on the words

creator_copy.observed: whole take from 0 s plus the 1.6 s outro; title, captions and SUPER EXCITED over the dining room at 0-4.2 s; at 16.3 s he speaks with no caption

expected_after_fix.editor_kept_source_spans: equal to the device recipe's keep segments (one span from just before the start line to just after the end line)
expected_after_fix.no_sliver_after_the_end_line: the original is ~1 ms longer than the proxy; the editor must not keep [proxy end, original end] as a second clip

local_take_window_check.command: python -m app.cli.verify_take_window --take <T1 take JSON: prod segments + kit whisper.cpp -l en words> --cleanup off --video T1_01_footage.mp4
